notes.zh:
- **Android 12 等系统上也能用后台屏**（#60）：有些系统（如 Android 12、部分 EMUI）不允许普通应用创建“受信任”的后台屏，之前会直接失败。现在会自动改用兼容模式的后台屏，能打开 App、点击和输入；限制是键盘可能弹在你的屏幕上、熄屏时后台屏也会暂停。诊断信息会写明是兼容模式
- **支持 OpenAI Responses 协议**（#59）：OpenAI、Ollama、LM Studio 和自定义服务商可以在“接口协议”里选 Responses
- **“测试”和“保存”分开**（#59）：服务商编辑页不再强制先测试才能保存
- **模型列表可以搜索**（#58）：模型多于 8 个时顶部出现搜索框
- **待办列表**（#58）：本轮全部完成后收成一行，之前轮次已完成的不再显示
- **缓存命中率**（#58）：每条回复的用量、轨迹和 设置 → 用量 里显示缓存命中率
- **运行状态更具体**：工具执行时，状态栏显示正在做什么（如“正在读取屏幕”）
- 这版没有在真机上测试过
- 仅支持 arm64-v8a，Android 10 及以上；正式签名，可直接覆盖安装，也可以在 设置 → 关于 里直接更新
notes.en:
- **Agent screen on Android 12 and similar systems** (#60): where the system doesn't allow a "trusted" agent screen (Android 12, some EMUI), the app now falls back to a compatibility-mode agent screen that can open apps, tap and type. Limits: the keyboard may appear on your screen, and the agent screen pauses when your screen is off. Diagnostics say when compatibility mode is used
- **OpenAI Responses protocol** (#59): OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio and custom providers can choose Responses under "API protocol"
- **Separate Test and Save** (#59): saving a provider no longer requires a test
- **Model search** (#58): a search field appears when a list has more than 8 models
- **Todo list** (#58): collapses to one line when everything is done this turn; finished lists from earlier turns are hidden
- **Cache hit rate** (#58): shown with token usage under replies, in the trajectory and in Settings → Usage
- **More specific running status**: while a tool runs, the status says what it is doing
- Not yet tested on a real device
